ex.s: AI can help identify the slightest signs of decay, such as cracks or discoloration, which are often invisible to the human eye. _____38_____ Moreover, by predicting future decay patterns, AI helps museums take preventive measures and improve preservation strategies.
ex.t: 人工智能可以帮助识别最轻微的损坏迹象，如裂纹或变色，这些往往肉眼难以察觉。____ 此外，通过预测未来的损坏趋势，人工智能帮助博物馆采取预防措施、改进保护策略。

ex.s: Moreover, we humans tend to assume that positive reviews might be fake.
ex.t: 此外，我们人类往往认为正面评论可能是假的。

ex.t: 此外，这些数据存在偏差，偏向某些地区、时段和物种。

ex.s: Moreover，the older you are，the more likely you will come to a resolution after an argument．This may be because more life experience usually leads to more defined priorities．You are more likely to distinguish between what matters and what does not．
ex.t: 此外年龄越大争论后达成解决方案的可能性越大这可能是因为更多的人生经历通常会导致更明确的优先级你更有可能区分什么是重要的什么是不重要的。

ex.s: Moreover, the USA has a track record of successfully accepting immigrants.
ex.t: 此外，美国有成功接受移民的历史记录。

ex.s: Moreover, how would you feel if you discovered that the people closest to you had been hiding the truth from you?
ex.t: 此外，如果你发现你最亲近的人一直在对你隐瞒真相，你会有什么感受？

ex.s: Moreover, what made Cunningham great was his devotion to photography, and the hours and hours of sheer hard work he put into his work.
ex.t: 此外，让坎宁安伟大的，是他对摄影的热爱，以及他投入工作中的大量纯粹的辛勤劳动。

ex.s: Moreover, (C) music gave me hope and a sense of satisfaction.
ex.t: 此外，（C）音乐给了我希望和满足感。

ex.s: Moreover, the Internet has made it possible for friends and family to keep in touch easily even if they are on opposite sides of the world.
ex.t: 此外，互联网使朋友和家人即使身处世界的两端也能轻松保持联系成为可能。

ex.s: Moreover, companies will probably (try) to do the same thing with planes soon afterwards.
